newsitem.title: DUBAI: Dubai gold imports surge in November - WGC.
newsitem.headline: Dubai gold imports surge in November - WGC.

text.p: Imports of gold bullion into the Gulf Arab emirate of Dubai surged to a record monthly high of 35.50 tonnes in November, figures released by the World Gold Council (WGC) in Dubai showed on Monday.
Imports in October were 28.41 tonnes while imports in the same month last year totalled 24.98 tonnes.
Imports in the first 11 months of the year totalled 318.52 tonnes, against 318.03 tonnes for the whole of 1995.

"The expectations are that the overseas demand from the (Indian) subcontinent will drive sales in the remainder of the year and early next year," said D.V. Pathy, WGC manager for Gulf and Business Development.
Dubai traders linked the record imports last month to lower prices and stock building ahead of the Indian wedding season which runs from the end of November to early February.
Sixteen countries, led by Switzerland and Britain with 26.16 tonnes and 7.31 tonnes, supplied the Dubai market in November, WGC data showed.
